name: Jest of the Shadowscape
body:
School: illusion (shadow); Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: personal

Target: you

Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

You gain concealment until the end of your next turn. If you have at least 1 rank in the Stealth skill, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your next attack roll.
